description: No comprehensive information security policy maintained and kept current.
applicability: This signal applies to: Organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data Security and compliance teams Human resources and training departments Third-party service providers (TPSPs) Incident response teams

related_controls: 12.1 - A comprehensive information security policy that governs and provides direction for protection of the entity's information assets is known and current
metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for the absence of a documented, board-approved information security policy. Verify that the policy addresses all PCI DSS requirements, is reviewed annually, and is distributed to all affected personnel. Check for policy version control and acknowledgment tracking.
